_source: overhead 2/Weather.vb (module Rain: loadRain, updateRain, renderRain), Clouds.vb (loadCloud, updateCloud, renderCloud), frmMain.vb Keys.W and Textures.vb, RECONSTRUCTION 14.1 and 14.2. Every figure was per rendered frame and is per 60 Hz tick here.

area._note: startX, startY, worldWidth and worldHeight (the area grid's size less one): random x is left + width * rnd, random y is top - height * rnd.

weather._note: maxRains 2500 (2,501 particles), RainWidth 0.04 and RainHeight RainWidth / 2 for setupVertex; particle n starts at z -1.5 - (n + 1) * 0.01, y without the lift; at z >= 0 it starts again at z -1.1, y lifted by 1. W steps through the cycle; the default is Snowing.

kinds._note: texSnow1: no leaf picture exists in the original

clouds._note: maxClouds 400 (401 clouds); cloud n at z -1.1 - n * 0.005; dX 0.003 * rnd + 0.001; Width 0.6 * rnd + 0.2, Height Width / 2 (setupVertex's half height); getRndInt(1, 2) picks cloud1 or cloud2 (cloud3 and cloud4 commented out); Cloud(0) to Cloud(3) are the balloon.
